annotations.text: Direction: 'the price terminal'. Familiar DoorDash/Grubhub information architecture (address, category row, card grid, store page) with our twist on every card: the delivered total on DoorDash, Uber Eats and Grubhub, cheapest highlighted in mint. Dark warm base, tangerine for actions, mint for savings, mono for every number.

Simple first: each card shows the cheapest app and one delivered price, plus one sentence on how much you save. The full three-app breakdown and the price history are on the restaurant page, collapsed under 'See how we got this'.
